THE NEW JAGUAR I-PACE
Every Jaguar feels like no other car on the road. Moving to all-electric power doesn't change this.
It offers even more opportunities to shape the dynamic performance and dramatic design for which
we're renowned. The New Jaguar I-PACE is a pure battery electric vehicle (BEV) built from the ground
up to embrace these new possibilities.
Radical design conceals an exquisite interior with SUV levels of practicality. A sophisticated, all-electric
powertrain provides high performance with zero tailpipe emissions. Its cutting-edge technologies work
seamlessly with the car and with you. Thrilling to look at and drive, easy to live with, and connected
like never before – the New I-PACE is our smartest five-seater sports car.
